name: 14all
description: Skills, hooks and read-only role agents for AI coding assistants. Early release; tried with Claude Code only.

interface.shortDescription: Working habits for coding agents: ask first, find the cause, test first, verify before done
interface.longDescription: 14All gives a coding agent better working habits: agree on what to build before building, find the real cause before fixing a bug, write the test first, and check that something works before saying it is done. Early release; tried with Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: I want to add a feature to this project. Help me agree on what to build first.
This test fails and I do not know why. Find the cause before changing anything.
